# Welcome to Dartastic Cloud Observatory

Your observability tenant. **OTel data ingest, deobfuscated stack traces, and Flutter-aware dashboards** — pre-configured and ready.

- [Setup guide](https://dartastic.io/help) · how to point your apps at your tenant.
- [Dartastic Pub](https://pub.dartastic.io) · the Dartastic package registry.
- [Dartastic Symbolizer](https://symbolizer.dartastic.io) · obfuscated traces → source lines.
- [Support](https://dartastic.io/support) · contact the team.

## Dart + Flutter observability

Your tenant ships with dashboards tuned for Dart server and Flutter mobile apps. The defaults:

- **Flutter App Health** — frames, jank, ANR, vsync, native heap. Updates automatically as your apps emit OTel.
- **Crashes — Symbolized** — production stack traces deobfuscated to source lines via the Dartastic Symbolizer.
- **Service Map** — your Dart server topology from OTLP spans.

### Send data

Point your OTel exporter at the Cloud OTLP endpoint:

```
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://otlp.cloud.dartastic.io
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS="authorization=Bearer <otlp-ingest-key>"
```

Mint an **OTLP ingest** key on the [Cloud tab](https://dartastic.io/dashboard?tab=cloud) at dartastic.io.
